message: Prepare the next controlled Aperture/three.js benchmark: live in-place edits of the existing crane in one persistent native WebGPU session. INITIAL READ-ONLY: inspect the approved runner and existing scene interfaces, propose a small shared adapter/evidence contract, and report readiness. No writes, tests, servers, browsers or descendants until separate bounded permit. Correlation: 50b15e618ffa4c4c4d009d6cb53bf5d88d892166cb6deaf6b015a0d0b7ab9a98. Repo /workspace/scratch/0190a8c72f8a/aperture-recovery-20261002; read AGENTS.md and tools/recovery/README.md. Existing clean sources are benchmarks/crane-wall-continuity-20261003/sources/a-continuous-front-quarter and b-continuous-front-quarter. Keep these and engine sources read-only. Later exclusive scope benchmarks/crane-live-edits-20261003/harness. You own a common loopback server/recorder, frozen shared contract, Node-only recorder tests, and runner using ONLY scripts/verified-webgpu.mjs runVerifiedScene inside adopted runtime_pressure lifecycle. Parent alone launches browsers. Separate authors will implement one engine each against your contract; do not implement their scenes. Keep source updates/identity checks genuine: one canvas, renderer/device, scene and worker per attempt; stable native entity/mesh identities, no reload/recreate-all between states. Use baseline then two cycles of each shoulder, elbow, hoist, arch, pipe, tier, assembly edit followed by baseline reset: 29 observed states total. Same1024-square fixed front camera and frozen per-engine appearance; existing seven edit values. The adapter must apply an edit and acknowledge the corresponding submitted frame, then expose actual native mesh buffers/matrices and identity/resource counters. Capture genuine canvas PNG after GPU fence/presentation and record native/source geometry for each state. Prefer same-origin POST of separate immutable state JSON/PNG files with bounded payloads rather than huge inline final JSON. A full baseline plus lossless changed-mesh records is acceptable only if all state geometry is independently reconstructible from surviving bytes; hashes alone are insufficient. Preserve all errors/partial states, never overwrite attempts. Final READY only after all state artifacts acknowledged and native verification; progress separate. Shared harness should own sequencing/capture and sanity-check stable identities/reset equivalence without claiming unmeasured GPU-memory or performance results. Three.js WebGL fallback disabled; Aperture app/worker/ECS plus existing meshes.publish/dynamic APIs. No new dependencies or engine changes. This is exploratory because exact model identity/full authentic transcripts are unavailable; no scores. Report the exact adapter contract promptly so independent author work can proceed. Report useful results right away, before scratch notes. If work remains, use collaboration.send_message; otherwise return the result. Keep your status report short; complete the research and deliverable at the depth the task requires. If authorization is missing, or the reviewer denies an action for that reason, pause and report the exact action, target, and blocker to me. If I send <transcript_evidence> that authorizes that action and target, proceed; if already denied, retry the same tool call once. Don’t add the evidence to tool arguments. If the evidence is insufficient or the retry is denied, stop and report back. If you delegate that action, forward the block unchanged.
